violations.text: (Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

(Shrimp ) was observed thawing in bucket on floor. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods must be thawed in one of the following manners: under refrigeration (41 degrees Fahrenheit or less); completely submerged under running water; as part of the cooking process; or in the microwave if cooked immediately after thawing. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/23/2026

The presence of (rodents ) is not controlled as evidenced by (droppings). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces have an accumulation of dust, dirt, food residue, and other debris: -food storage shelves in kitchen -food storage bins -food storage shelves in walk in -stove/wok area -prep units interior and exterior Non food contact areas must be keep cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The floors throughout the facility have an accumulation of soil residue and/or food debris. The physical facilities shall be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by (boxes and equipment ). A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Raw animal foods (shelled eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (produce) in the walk-in refrigerator. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

(Various food product) was observed not marked with the date of preparation. Ready-to-eat time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods prepared in the establishment and held for more than 24 hours must be marked with the date of preparation. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Working containers of (dry and liquid ingredients ) are not labeled with the common name of the food. Working containers holding food or food ingredients that are removed from their original packages, such as flour, herbs, salt, sugar, and spices must be labeled with the common name of the food. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The presence of (rodents ) is not controlled as evidenced by (nesting material and droppings). The presence of insects, rodents, and other pests must be controlled by routinely inspecting the premises for evidence of pests, using acceptable methods to control pests, eliminating harborage conditions, and routinely inspecting incoming shipments of food and supplies. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026
Various food product were observed stored on the floor in the walk in cooler and kitchen area. Food must be stored at least 6 inches above the floor. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

The following non-food contact surfaces observed with debris: 1.prep units exterior and interior observed with soil residue and food debris 2.food storage shelves in kitchen have food residue and other debris 3.food storage bins have an accumulation of debris. 4.food storage shelves in walk in cooler have debris 5.ingredient cart has food debris 6.stove/wok area observed with grease buildup and food debris Non food contact areas must be cleaned as often as necessary to keep them clean. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026
Outside dumpster area observed with litter and/or other debris. New Violation. Correct By: 07/09/2026

Unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment or items were observed in the (kitchen) area. Establishments shall be kept free of unnecessary and/or non-functional equipment and litter to prevent harborage conditions. Repeat Violation. Correct By: 07/30/2026

New Violation. Correct By: 02/03/2025
